# `sngl dump --format sngl` prints IR back as source, so what it prints has to be
# source. Slots gave it three ways not to be: the declarations live in
# Component.Slots rather than Props, so the parameter list came out empty; a
# population lives in NodeInst.Slots rather than Children, so it vanished; and a
# component whose default slot set ChildrenType printed both, which is refused on
# the way back in.
#
# The check is the round trip, not the text: dump it, check the dump.

sngl dump --stage checked --format sngl slots.sngl
stdout 'slot header tr.one'
stdout 'slot _,'
stdout 'slot cell\(Row\)'

cp stdout out.sngl
sngl check out.sngl
stdout 'out.sngl: ok'

-- slots.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import tr "sngl://tree"

struct Row {
    title string
}

component table(
    rows list<Row>,
    slot _ tr.default,
    slot header tr.one,
    slot cell(Row),
) {
    vbox {
        header {
            text(value="(untitled)")
        }
        for r = rows {
            cell(r)
        }
        slot
    }
}

component main {
    table(rows=[Row{title = "a"}]) {
        slot header {
            text(value="Rows")
        }
        slot cell(row) {
            text(value=row.title)
        }
        text(value="ordinary")
    }
}
